guide.title: Guide for beneficiaries
guide.subtitle: What happens after a vault is handed over to you.

steps.title: Check your email and sign in
steps.text: You receive an email when a vault is handed over to you. Sign in to LegacyVault with the same email address.

steps.title: Verify your identity
steps.text: Confirm it is you with a one-time code sent to your email. The code expires after a few minutes.

steps.title: Accept the handover
steps.text: Each beneficiary responds on their own. Accept to receive your share, or decline and it passes to the backup beneficiary, if the owner named one. Declining cannot be undone.

steps.title: View and save the assets
steps.text: Download the information you need and store it safely. Delete downloaded files once you have saved them.

steps.title: Close the handover case
steps.text: Confirm that you have received everything. Closing the case cannot be undone.

tips: Act before the claim deadline shown on each vault. After it, the content is archived.
Keep the death certificate and identity documents of the owner ready for legal procedures.
For inheritance procedures, consider contacting a licensed lawyer or notary in your area.
